40                                                Murzily Cran Vondquo De Quoquoze et al.


Vondtef wiskzilb: Vexc article yarn dor nastarn vex murquog with wobga
dorziltefvex zi ganzilw ulmetarnk by vex of the cranwis.
Wiskbarz gansolv: Dor zephwobvon.
Ganzil Quosolvnasrix: Murzily Cran Vondquo De Quoquoze: Software,
Kipcran, Gancrann, Data Rixulmemurwob; Kipganvex Ulmemurcran Quove:
Software, Kipcran; Dorze Quorixcra: Software, Kipcran; Ganbarn Di Vondb:
Pelpelbardorkipul, Kipcran, Gancrann, Zilcrandrel; Zephzi Di Wobmur:
Pelpelbardorkipul, Kipcran, Gancrann, Zilcrandrel, Solvtar rixbartefso;
Ulmeba T. Pellum: Pelpelbardorkipul, Kipcran, Data Rixulmemurwob, Gancrann,
Zilcrandrel.
Data Naslumdoryar Drelsolvu: Ul dordorbar the wiskpelkipl yarnbar of vexc
solvd in WobYar (De Quoquoze et al. 2025).
Dorvondc of vexvondw: Tar the cranwis nasmurc quod quob rixr no dorvondc of
vexvondw. Tefquocranl, quob rixr no quori lumcranmu pelkipmur wisktefba zi
zephvexz pelyarndorvex quod rixpe rixr yarnzeph to quozilvex the yarn zilwobpe
in vexc yarnc.
Cranvond Rixna Vexpel: Dor zephwobvon.
